emptyRoom: No briefing data. Generate this file with forma room.
printAll: Printing shows every view, not only the open one.
thesis: {blocked} things need you out of {open} open across {programs} programmes.
noBlocked: Nothing is waiting on you in this snapshot.
closedOpenChart: Closed and open work across the portfolio
planCoverageNote: {withIssues} of {requirements} written requirements have work behind them.
planCoverageMissing: This programme declares no requirements matrix, so the plan cannot be measured — only the volume of work can.
whereWeWere: Where we were, where we are
historyMissing: This snapshot predates issue dates, so history cannot be derived from it. Re-run forma verify.
historyNote: Derived from one snapshot: an issue counts as open on a day when it existed and was not yet closed.
historyUnplaceable: {n} closed issues carry no closing date and are left out of the series.
techBuckets: Every issue, by what is known about it
techHonesty: What this briefing does not know
rulesComplete: Every programme declares its blocking rule.
ruleUnknown: Blocking rule not declared. Its issues are counted as neither blocked nor moving.
allMilestoned: Every open issue has a milestone.
behind: Architecture source is {n} commits behind HEAD.
noDrift: No architecture map, so commit drift is unavailable.
sweepsNone: No commit exceeded the file threshold.
sweepsCount: {n} commits touched more files than the threshold. They are counted here and attributed to no node.
mapMissing: Architecture map missing. No model and topology were supplied for this programme.
timelineMissing: This programme declares no architecture timeline, so there is nothing beyond the current state.
timelineNote: Completion per checkpoint is issue closure on the nodes that checkpoint touches — not an estimate.
wbsMissing: This programme declares no requirements matrix. Add an rtm block to its manifest entry to derive one.
wbsHoles: What the matrix does not cover
wbsComplete: The matrix has no holes: every requirement lands on work, and every open issue is claimed.
wbsQueueFlat: No label family reached the threshold, so this is one list.
docsNone: This programme declares no documents. Add docs.include to its manifest entry.
optHowToChange: Change what is here by editing {file} and running forma room again. forma scan rewrites the programme list from a directory of checkouts without discarding what you turned off.
